text:
maya: heads-up I opened a tiny docs PR adding a tracing-hook example focused on latency + cost breakdowns. Includes a compact JS + Go snippet and a note about sampling rates. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1291 :sparkles:

ravi: nice. can you also include a one-line example showing tracekey-based grouping? customers ask for that a lot.

maya: added a 1-liner for tracekey grouping in both snippets. kept them short so they fit into the quick reference card.

alex: quick nit: our SDKs accept `tracekey` (one word) and we normalize it. also, mention that span sampling < 1.0 will make the latency chart sparse.

maya: updated to `tracekey` and added a sentence about sampling + recommended default 0.1 for early staging.

ravi: is the dashboard link stable? earlier we had name/alias mismatches. suggest linking by ID.

maya: good call. switched to dashboard ID link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-109-latency-cost

alex: also add a troubleshooting tip: "If latency or cost shows zeros, check metric alias mapping: latency_span_duration -> obs_latency_ms_total". saved a customer last quarter.

maya: added triage note and a 1-line TTL remark (short TTLs -> more misses -> higher cost per request).

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #1291 44d linkcheck flagged console external link as external (approve if intended).

deploy-bot: FYI platform change required: alias mapping update scheduled in next deploy (deploy window 21:00 UTC).

maya: thanks! action items: 1) alex to verify sampling blurb 2) ravi to sanity-check Go snippet 3) maya to squash and request final review 4) ops to push alias mapping in deploy. I'll ping when ready.

alex: quick review done, LGTM. one tiny wording tweak on the sampling sentence.

ravi: Go snippet looks good, just changed a var name for clarity.

maya: squashed and updated wording. requesting final thumbs from @alex and @ravi. :pray:
